items.title: Train transformers on an ESP32
items.oneliner: This repo trains a small transformer from scratch on an $8 ESP32-S3, proving on-device learning is practical.

items.title: Run ternary MoE on iPhone
items.oneliner: Open weights and instructions for a 20B ternary MoE that reportedly runs at 120 tok/s on iPhone.

items.title: Catch Rust aliasing bugs faster
items.oneliner: Dynamic analyzer for Rust unsafe code that finds Tree Borrows aliasing violations faster than Miri in mixed-language apps.

items.title: Embed Rio terminal engine anywhere
items.oneliner: Rust crate and C library that expose Rio's VT engine without a full terminal app, including search and selection.

items.title: Tile macOS windows by columns
items.oneliner: Open-source macOS tiling window manager with scrolling columns, workspaces, hotkeys, IPC control, and TOML rules.

items.title: Give Emacs a glass UI
items.oneliner: Patch and build steps that add live-tunable transparent glass effects to Emacs on macOS.

items.title: Generate more inclusive skin tones
items.oneliner: Practical color-space demo with JavaScript and Python code for procedurally generating diverse human skin tones.

items.title: Use GitHub's fast casefold crate
items.oneliner: Open-source Rust crate from GitHub code search that performs Unicode case folding at near memory speed.

items.title: Test whether PDFs parse cleanly
items.oneliner: Hands-on guide for validating ATS-friendly PDFs, including text-layer checks, metadata tests, and ligature pitfalls.

items.title: Build bird-call flashcards with audio
items.oneliner: Step-by-step hardware tutorial for an RFID audio player that teaches bird calls with tap-to-play cards.
